infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: STR needs access to your photo library so you can choose a picture from your camera roll to use as your profile avatar, or attach a progress photo to a workout entry. For example, you can select an existing photo of yourself to display as your avatar on your profile and to friends in the social feed.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: STR uses your camera so you can take a new photo directly within the app to use as your profile avatar or attach as a progress photo to a workout entry. For example, you can snap a gym mirror photo right after a workout to attach to that session.
